title_as_printed: Experimentally determined densities (rho, g cm^-3) for CO2-H2O mixtures at 400C
pressure_note: Pressure P (MPa) given in the tables, isobaric-isothermal conditions; paper states accuracy +-0.02 MPa; not otherwise defined (flow-through cell, no vapour phase; total pressure presumed but not stated)
notes: Printed as a wide table (X_CO2 in column headers, P in rows, 11 pressures x 9 compositions), restacked here to long form, ordered by X_CO2 then P. Single-phase supercritical mixture (flow-through densimeter); density of the mixture as a whole, not gas-loaded water.
